observations: Photo 0 shows a man in a grey work uniform with 'FUELLET' on the chest, standing on a pile of used car engines.
Photo 1 and 2 show a single engine and transmission assembly wrapped in clear plastic film.
The engine is a 4-cylinder inline configuration with a black intake manifold.
The transmission is a 5-speed manual unit.
The engine is mounted on a metal support bracket.
The seller's text mentions Toyota, Lexus, Hyundai, Honda engines and gearbox.

claims.claim: We sale all kinds of toyota,lexus,Hyundai, Honda engines and gearbox
claims.evidence: The photos show one engine and transmission, but no brand or model plates are legible.

risks.risk: The engine may be a different brand or model than claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine model code stamped on the engine block.

risks.risk: The engine may be non-functional or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running and a compression test result.

risks.risk: The transmission may be faulty or have internal wear.
risks.proof: A video of the transmission shifting gears.

risks.risk: The engine may be missing the original air filter and oil filter.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine bay with all filters installed.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine model code stamped on the metal block.
Video of the engine running and the transmission shifting.
Photo of the engine bay with the air filter and oil filter installed.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
